sentences.text: 3. It is the case of prosecution as per the complaint averments in brief that the victim girl was under care and custody of her grandmother as her parents died and victim was a minor and accused approached her and making her to believe that he will marry the victim, committed penetrative sexual assault repeatedly and in this regard a complaint was lodged and accused was in custody.

Further, when this being the fact, it is stated that on 13.12.2023 the accused returned from jail and once again went to the house of the victim and making her to believe that he would marry the victim,
repeatedly committed penetrative sexual assault making the victim girl pregnant.
Therefore, with NC: 2026:KHC-D:3345 HC-KAR these allegations a complaint is lodged.
It is also alleged that if the victim does not co-operate with the accused, then he would kill the victim and in such threaten criminally intimidated her.
Therefore, a complaint is lodged for the alleged offences as stated supra.

4. Learned counsel for the appellant/accused submitted that this is the second complaint lodged by the victim and is in the habit of making complaint against the accused and moreover the victim herself turned hostile in this case.
Further it is alleged that the accused got acquitted.
Therefore, the entire prosecution case is false and hence prays to release the appellant/accused on bail.

5. On the other hand, learned HCGP filed statement of objections and vehemently opposed the appeal on the ground that the victim is a minor and though the accused was in jail for the first offence and thereafter returning from prison to the village, he committed the offence once again and made her to become pregnant.
Therefore, when this NC: 2026:KHC-D:3345 HC-KAR being the repeated penetrative sexual assault on the minor victim, learned HCGP prays not to grant bail and prays to dismiss the appeal.
6. Having considered the complaint averments, the victim was a minor.

Knowing this fact the accused had developed intimacy with the minor victim and had committed the offence of penetrative sexual assault for which a crime was registered in the year 2023 for the same offence.
The accused was acquitted for the alleged offence in the above stated case.

After returning from prison, the accused once again had approached the victim and once again had committed the offence of repeated penetrative sexual assault and therefore the instant complaint is filed.

Hence,
though the victim has turned hostile when she was examined, but considering the offence alleged is not only individual to the victim minor girl, but the offence is treated to be committed against the State.

Therefore, when the prosecution case is that the appellant/accused has committed repeated penetrative sexual assault, turning NC: 2026:KHC-D:3345 HC-KAR hostile by the minor victim is not a criterion for releasing the appellant/accused on bail for the reasons stated above.
7. It is submitted that now evidence of victim girl is completed and examination of other witnesses is yet to be completed.
Therefore, the Court is of the opinion that till completion of examination of all witnesses, it is not feasible to release the accused on bail.
Therefore, the present appeal is liable to be dismissed.
